sessionId.description: Owning FarmDash session id (the session that owns the fee event).

sessionToken.description: Optional in this raw-HTTP schema: the session credential may be sent in the request body or via the X-FarmDash-Session-Token header. It authenticates the FarmDash session only; it is not wallet signing or transaction authority, and FarmDash never broadcasts the swap on the caller's behalf.

feeEventId.description: FarmDash fee-event id associated with the prepared swap.

txHash.description: On-chain transaction hash, which exists only after the customer-controlled wallet broadcast. A transaction hash alone is not confirmation: FarmDash verifies the canonical receipt/finality and the expected fee transfer before durable settlement is recorded.
